reviews.title: Excellent app even with bugs!!
reviews.contents: This app contains everything that you need to help your child learn how to use the restroom! I have also given a couple other apps a shot and they FAIL in comparison to this app. Even with a bug, it is still worth purchasing. EVERY DAY when I first use the app, it bugs out on me. I can open the app, tap on my child’s profile, but I can’t log the first of the morning’s “activities,” because the activities page bugs out and blanks out. However, I can still use the timer which is more useful. This is difficult for me considering that I have acquired a TBI (traumatic brain injury ) and have a hard time remembering details for a prolonged period of time, which is normally how long it takes before the activities page begins to work for some reason. Normally, I would try to compensate somehow, but considering I paid for this app, I am hoping that the bug will be fixed!!!!

reviews.title: Very Helpful!
reviews.contents: My husband and I both downloaded this app and got the subscription for 3 months so we could link up our phones and track our daughters progress. It’s a very helpful app for potty training and helped us identify her holding patterns and how to help her. Just in case you’re also potty training a delightfully willful, stubborn and mildly autistic child, Betty still has to use the bathtub for pee often because she can’t relax on the potty sometimes and needs water around her feet to help her go. She has an insane ability to hold pee and poo so we are using Chillax gummies, LuvBug probiotics, apple juice and Belvita fiber crackers to keep her regular. Consistency is key! Same potty every day is key! Thank you for this app and helping us track and communicate on this daily.

reviews.title: Just needed an app to help keep track
reviews.contents: My daughter is 2 and I've really been lazy about potty training her but during the lockdown and because I'm a teacher I felt it was important to ensure she goes back to her preschool where I also work fully potty trained. I needed an app that helped me keep track and had a timer that would allow me to keep a schedule for her. It's simple to use don't need the internet to use and had no in app purchases. It's been a week I only use pullups at bed time will work on night training soon. While she's on the potty I keep my phone close so she can see the confetti when the app celebrates her using the potty and she loves that. As a preschool teacher I recommend this app.

reviews.title: Great for co parenting & super easy!
reviews.contents: Love that my daughters dad and I can both use the app and all the info is synced so we can see the info on each other’s time. Also super easy to use, love how easy and accessible everything is! The only recommendation I have is to add a “Wet” button. Cause for our potty training method we are doing underwear all day but then diaper at nap and bedtime and when the diapers are wet from that I don’t like to consider it an accident especially so early on in our potty training journey. So it’s nice if she wakes up dry I click dry but if she wakes up wet I’d rather be able to click wet, rather than considering it an accident.

reviews.title: Highly recommended as of so far
reviews.contents:
This app has remarkably advised me through exactly what I was seeking for. It’s exceedingly easy and accessible for anyone who is considering or debating on whether or not it’s worth it. I’ve never rated an app before because I’ve always seen it as a waste of time, but for this particular app it’s helped me tremendously. 

I consistently have had issues with my nerves because of the structure of my spinal cord. With that being said this app is great for not only children but for anyone who seeks this outstanding aid as myself. 

Thank you for creating such a wonderful and pleasing app, very much appreciated.

reviews.title: Great app But... sound needs to be optional and be able to be turned off
reviews.contents: I like how this can be used by any age and how you can track your bowel movements and when you’re urinating. Very helpful to keep track of leaks. However I would love to be able to turn off the sound because when you’re trying to be discreet about keeping a diary about your bathroom habits a lot of the sounds can be very obnoxious when they go off. Other than turning off the device volume there’s no other way to get rid of the sound and I would love to see this as an option. I would like the option to be able to choose what sort of celebration emoji’s are used and whether or not there’s sound. PLEASE MAKE THE SOUNDS OPTIONAL!!

reviews.title: Overall great for data collection
reviews.contents:
I love the simplicity of  how to use the app. The only recommendations I would have are: 
1) Options to choose a different sound for alarms. My child would do better with something more musical or softer in tone.
2) I love you can see the notes you write on the long timeline! I would however like to have a little more detail with maybe how long the child sat on the potty each time, and possibly when dry what they wore (I.e. diaper, undies, nothing). 

Data logging is great! Price point is perfect! Unlimited people is awesome! As a behavior analyst, this will come in handy for potty training behaviors for work too. :)

reviews.title: Great so far
reviews.contents:
We’re a few weeks along with potty training and it has been a bumpy ride.  I hadn’t been keeping a log because I felt like we were doing okay.  However, his difficulties at daycare made me realize I needed to start really tracking what was going on over all. 

This app is really easy to use. I like that I can make an entry with a couple taps and come back later to update with more information.  

I would like for “parents” to be changed to “caregiver” to be more inclusive.  It would also be nice to have a “home/daycare/away” option along with a “dressed/undressed self” checkbox.

reviews.title: Works for one parent
reviews.contents:
This app works great as a simple tracker if only one person is keeping track.  You can invite another parent but the app does not sync, so any activity on either parents phone does not sync :( including timers.  All activities and timers must be tracked/set separately.  Not what I wanted so regret spending money on it.  But for one person it works fine.

Edit: I am giving the app 5 stars as it works great, it just does not have a particular function I need. 
Support was quick to get back to me also which is definitely a plus :)

reviews.title: Great for keeping track
reviews.contents:
I find this easy to use and it’s great for keeping track when your child went pee or poo. I was happily surprised that you can list the pee or poo as an accident so after the day is done you can see at a glance how the day went. 

My only issue with is that when adding a child the birth year only goes back to 2009. Most people potty training are going to want to select an earlier year. But in the end it doesn’t matter what year you choose as it makes no difference unless you have multiple children potty training.
